description: This file implements a request cache for streaming requests (exec, attach, port-forward) in Kubernetes, managing tokens for request retrieval and expiration.

classes.name: requestCache
classes.description: A cache for streaming requests that manages token generation, expiration, and retrieval.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a request into the cache and returns a unique token.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a request from the cache based on the token.
